arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/tests && cat > t_state.py <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from harness import run, t, done

r = run([{'op':'about'}, 'broken', {'op':'nope'}, {'op':'about','x':1},
         {'op':'advance','time':5}, {'op':'about'}])
t('about/invalid', r, [
    {'status':'ok','protocol':'forest-controller/3'},
    {'status':'invalid'}, {'status':'invalid'}, {'status':'invalid'},
    {'status':'error','code':'NOT_LOADED','rev':0},
    {'status':'ok','protocol':'forest-controller/3'}])

r = run([{'op':'advance','time':1.0}, {'op':'advance','time':True},
         {'op':'advance','time':'5'}, {'op':'advance','time':10**13},
         {'op':'advance','time':-1}])
t('int strict', r, [{'status':'invalid'}]*5)

load = {'op':'load','n':3,'links':[[0,1,10],[1,2,5]],
        'bookings':[{'id':'b1','owner':'o1','window':[0,10],'envelope':[[0,3]]}]}
r = run([load, load])
t('load twice', r, [{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0},
                    {'status':'error','code':'ALREADY_LOADED','rev':0}])

bad_load = {'op':'load','n':2,'links':[[0,1,5]],
            'bookings':[{'id':'b','owner':'o','window':[0,4],'envelope':[[0,6]]}]}
r = run([bad_load, {'op':'audit','at':[]}])
t('overbook load invalid', r, [{'status':'invalid'},
                               {'status':'error','code':'NOT_LOADED','rev':0}])

later = {'op':'load','n':2,'links':[[0,1,5]],
         'bookings':[{'id':'b','owner':'o','window':[0,4],'envelope':[[0,6]]}]}
r = run([load, later])
t('later load skip overlap', r, [{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0},
                                 {'status':'error','code':'ALREADY_LOADED','rev':0}])

bad2 = {'op':'load','n':2,'links':[[0,1,5],[0,1,5]],'bookings':[]}
r = run([load, bad2])
t('later load structural', r, [{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0},{'status':'invalid'}])

r = run([load, {'op':'audit','at':[0,3,0,10]}])
t('audit', r[1], {'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0,'leases':['b1'],
       'samples':[[0,[7,5]],[3,[7,5]],[0,[7,5]],[10,[10,5]]]})

r = run([load, {'op':'advance','time':5}, {'op':'audit','at':[5,0]}])
t('audit time', r[2], {'status':'error','code':'TIME','rev':1})

r = run([load, {'op':'advance','time':10}, {'op':'audit','at':[10]}])
t('advance expire', r[1], {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':10,'expired':['b1']})
t('audit after expire', r[2], {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':10,'leases':[],
                               'samples':[[10,[10,5]]]})
r = run([load, {'op':'advance','time':5}, {'op':'advance','time':5}])
t('noop advance', r[2], {'status':'ok','rev':2,'now':5,'expired':[]})

r = run([load, {'op':'edit','rev':0,'changes':[[1,20]],'force':False}])
t('edit ok', r[1], {'status':'ok','rev':1,'cancelled':[]})
r = run([load, {'op':'edit','rev':5,'changes':[],'force':False}])
t('edit stale', r[1], {'status':'stale','rev':0})
r = run([load, {'op':'edit','rev':0,'changes':[[7,3]],'force':False}])
t('edit reference', r[1], {'status':'error','code':'REFERENCE','rev':0})
r = run([load, {'op':'edit','rev':0,'changes':[[0,2]],'force':False}])
t('edit blocked', r[1], {'status':'blocked','rev':0,'link':0,'time':0,'used':3,'capacity':2})
r = run([load, {'op':'edit','rev':0,'changes':[[0,2]],'force':True}])
t('edit force', r[1], {'status':'ok','rev':1,'cancelled':['b1']})

done()
EOF
python3 t_state.py
